decks.notes: This deck focuses on a strategy that combines aggressive creatures with the ability to repeatedly blink them in and out of play for various benefits. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can generate additional value from entering the battlefield effects and protect key creatures from removal spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggressive threats and disruptive plays, ultimately outpacing and outmaneuvering them to secure victory. The deck's synergy and versatility make it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building card advantage and controlling the board. The inclusion of creatures with disruptive abilities like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus can help maintain control of the game. Additionally, the deck includes graveyard interaction with cards like Unearth and Graveyard Trespasser, adding another layer of disruption. The mana base is optimized to provide access to all necessary colors while minimizing potential drawbacks.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, supported by burn spells and anthem effects to enhance their power. It includes a mix of low-cost creatures with abilities that benefit the board and higher-cost creatures to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers and enchantments further enhances the aggressive strategy, while also providing some control elements. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures, direct damage, and disruption, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to combo with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Valgavoth, Terror Eater, creating explosive plays. It also incorporates unique cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's flexibility and creativity in its card choices allow for unexpected and diverse ways to win the game, making it a challenging and exciting archetype to play.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu while supporting them with Leyline of the Guildpact and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional synergy and power. Lightning Bolt helps to control the board while Stubborn Denial provides protection for key threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed with fetchlands and shocklands. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a mix of creatures, removal, and disruptive spells.

The primary focus of this Jeskai Control deck is to efficiently control the board through a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures. With cards like Supreme Verdict and Wrath of the Skies for board wipes, Spell Snare and Prismatic Ending for removal, and Galvanic Discharge and Flame of Anor for direct damage, the deck aims to keep the opponent's threats in check. The inclusion of cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, and Thundertrap Trainer provide additional value and win conditions to help close out the game. Additionally, the deck includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and access to all necessary colors.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by utilizing cheap aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, while also supporting them with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. By efficiently using card draw and burn spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Tower, and Power Plant) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It includes powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Karn, the Great Creator is used to search for artifacts like Chalice of the Void to further control the game. The deck also includes spell and creature removal like Dismember and Kozilek's Command to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through efficient mana generation and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces needed to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief, and Glaring Fleshraker alongside Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, the deck can quickly gain advantage and control the game. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command provide additional removal and disruption options, while Emrakul, the Promised End acts as a powerful finisher. The inclusion of key lands like Grove of the Burnwillows and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to ensure consistency and resiliency.

The main concept of this deck is to be aggressive with creatures like Emperor of Bones and Quantum Riddler, while also utilizing blink effects like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to protect and reuse key creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game. The mana base is designed to support all the color requirements of the deck and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing Leyline of Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact to maintain control over the opponent's board while consistently putting pressure with aggressive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Scion of Draco, and Territorial Kavu. The deck is also supported by powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The mana base is designed for flexibility and consistency, allowing the deck to operate smoothly and adapt to various matchups. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently through a combination of aggression and control elements.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through removal spells and prevent the opponent from establishing a strong board presence. This is achieved through cards like Path to Exile, Wrath of the Skies, and Solitude. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Crucible of Worlds to generate additional value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Relic of Progenitus and March of Otherworldly Light to disrupt the opponent's graveyard interactions. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, and Force of Negation. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Pest Control. Additionally, it utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Unearth and Cling to Dust. The win condition for this deck is to establish a card advantage through card draw and disruptive creatures like Harbinger of the Seas and Murktide Regent, while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using a combination of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, Scion of Draco, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Territorial Kavu. The deck also includes instant removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to control the board. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact provide additional support and synergy with the creatures in the deck. The mana base is built to support the multiple colors needed for the deck, utilizing fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and removal spells.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful combo involving Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate infinite mana and deal lethal damage to the opponent. It uses cards like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to help ramp up and search for key combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to control the board and protect the combo. Overall, the strategy revolves around setting up the combo pieces efficiently and overwhelming the opponent with a game-winning play.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures to overwhelm the opponent, utilizing cards like Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls to cast them ahead of schedule. Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End disrupt the opponent's game plan while providing a clock to end the game. Sowing Mycospawn and Nulldrifter provide additional value and card advantage, while Kozilek's Command offers flexibility in dealing with threats. The deck aims to close out games quickly with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, making it a formidable force in the Modern format.
